translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year's spring, princes and Mongols planned a honorific for Taizong and sent Ying'e'erdai to Korea to explain.

sentences.zh: 既至，倧謝不延納，令英俄爾岱詣所置議政府陳說，設兵晝夜環守使邸。

translations.literal: When he arrived, Jong declined to receive him and had Ying'e'erdai go to the established Council of State to state his case; troops were posted day and night around the envoy's residence.
translations.idiomatic: Jong refused audience, confined him to the Council of State, and ringed the lodge with troops.

sentences.zh: 英俄爾岱率諸從者奪民間馬，突門而出。

translations.literal: Ying'e'erdai led his followers to seize civilian horses and burst out through the gate.
translations.idiomatic: He seized civilian horses and broke out through the gate.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮王遣騎持報書追付英俄爾岱而別，以書誡其邊臣令守界，英俄爾岱並奪之以聞。

translations.literal: The Korean king sent horsemen with a reply to catch Ying'e'erdai and deliver it; separately he wrote admonishing his frontier officials to guard the border; Ying'e'erdai seized both and reported them.
translations.idiomatic: Korean riders delivered a reply and a border warning; he seized both and reported them.

sentences.zh: 又遇明皮島兵遮歸路，擊走之。

translations.literal: He also met Ming Pidao troops blocking the return road and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Ming troops from Pidao blocked his return; he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 崇德改元，討朝鮮，師克王都，倧出奔南漢城。

translations.literal: When the era name changed to Chongde, Korea was punished; the army took the royal capital and Jong fled to Namhansanseong.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chongde the court attacked Korea, took the capital, and Jong fled to Namhansanseong.

sentences.zh: 二年春，上使英俄爾岱及馬福塔齎敕詰責，朝鮮以書謝。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year the emperor sent Ying'e'erdai and Mafuta with an imperial edict to rebuke them; Korea replied with a letter of apology.
translations.idiomatic: In the second spring he and Mafuta rebuked Korea by edict; Korea apologized in writing.

sentences.zh: 師益進，薄南漢城，復使英俄爾岱、馬福塔招倧出城相見，倧答書始稱臣，然猶逡巡不敢出。

translations.literal: The army pressed on to Namhansanseong; Ying'e'erdai and Mafuta were again sent to summon Jong out of the city to meet; Jong's reply first called himself subject but he still hesitated and dared not come out.
translations.idiomatic: At Namhansanseong they summoned Jong to meet; he styled himself subject but would not come out.

sentences.zh: 上诇知倧寄孥江華島，命睿親王多爾袞以偏師下之，獲其妃及諸子。

translations.literal: Learning that Jong had sent his family to Ganghwa Island, the emperor ordered Prince Regent Dorgon with a detached force to take it and captured his consort and sons.
translations.idiomatic: Learning Jong's family was on Ganghwa, Dorgon took the island and captured consort and sons.

sentences.zh: 倧乃出降，上留其二子為質，命英俄爾岱、馬福塔送其妃及諸戚屬還王都。

translations.literal: Jong then came out to surrender; the emperor kept two sons as hostages and ordered Ying'e'erdai and Mafuta to escort his consort and kinsmen back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jong surrendered; two sons were kept as hostages while consort and kin were escorted home.

sentences.zh: 二月，班師，倧出送，命英俄爾岱、馬福塔宣諭，仍送之還。

translations.literal: In the second month, as the army withdrew, Jong came out to see them off; Ying'e'erdai and Mafuta were ordered to proclaim the decree and escort him back.
translations.idiomatic: On withdrawal Jong saw the army off; the envoys proclaimed the decree and escorted him back.

sentences.zh: 旋授議政大臣。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed a Deliberative Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became a Deliberative Minister.

sentences.zh: 十月，復命英俄爾岱、馬福塔齎敕印使朝鮮，封倧仍為朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Ying'e'erdai and Mafuta were again ordered with edict and seal as envoys to Korea to invest Jong again as king of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he and Mafuta reinvested Jong as king.

sentences.zh: 四年，授固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he became banner commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，上以倧繕城郭，積芻糧，欺罔巧飾，使英俄爾岱及鄂莫克圖齎敕詰責，倧上表謝罪。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because Jong repaired walls, stored fodder and grain, and deceived with artifice, Ying'e'erdai and Emoketu were sent with an edict to rebuke him; Jong submitted a memorial of apology.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Jong's fortifications and stores drew rebuke via Edict; he apologized.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，睿親王多爾袞復攻錦州，九月，貝勒多鐸等圍松山，英俄爾岱皆在行間。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year Prince Regent Dorgon again attacked Jinzhou; in the ninth month Prince Duo Duo and others besieged Songshan; Ying'e'erdai was present throughout.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 at Jinzhou and Songshan he served throughout the campaigns.

sentences.zh: 七年，復使朝鮮鞫獄，還奏稱旨。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was again sent to Korea to try cases and returned reporting that he had accorded with the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he tried cases in Korea to the emperor's satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 八年，考滿，進三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, on completing his term, he was promoted to third-rank jingginiha fan.
translations.idiomatic: Term completion in year 8 brought third-rank jingginiha fan.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從睿親王多爾袞入關。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Regent Dorgon through the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he followed Dorgon through the pass.

sentences.zh: 是年，改承政為尚書，英俄爾岱仍任戶部。

translations.literal: That year "chief" was changed to "minister" and Ying'e'erdai remained at the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: That year he remained Revenue minister when titles changed.

sentences.zh: 二年，？

translations.literal: In the second year, for
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, for

sentences.zh: 功，封三等公。

translations.literal: merit he was enfeoffed as third-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: merit he was made third-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 三年，奏請、軍械、火器，以杜盜源，從之。

translations.literal: In the third year he memorialized requesting prohibition of private sale among the people of horses, military gear, and firearms, to cut off theft at the source; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he memorialized to ban private sale of horses, arms, and firearms; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 四年，考滿，進二等公。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on completing his term, he was promoted to second-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: Term completion in year 4 raised him to second-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，卒。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year's second month.

translations.literal: Posthumously he was remembered for
translations.idiomatic: He was remembered for

sentences.zh: 禁民間私售馬

translations.literal: prohibiting private sale of horses among the people.
translations.idiomatic: banning private horse sales among the people.

sentences.zh: 英俄爾岱娶饒餘郡王阿巴泰女，授多羅額駙。

translations.literal: Ying'e'erdai married the daughter of Prince Raoyu Abatai and was appointed Prince Consort.
translations.idiomatic: He married Abatai's daughter and became Prince Consort.

sentences.zh: 領戶部十餘年，既領固山，仍綜部政。

translations.literal: He headed the Board of Revenue for more than ten years; even after heading a banner he still oversaw board affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He ran Revenue over ten years and kept board duties even after taking a banner.

sentences.zh: 屢坐事論罰，而恩顧不稍衰。

translations.literal: Repeatedly punished for offenses, yet imperial favor did not diminish.
translations.idiomatic: Though often punished, imperial favor never waned.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘗諭？

translations.literal: Taizong once instructed the
translations.idiomatic: Taizong once told

sentences.zh: 臣曰：「英俄爾岱性素執拗，其於本旗人亦偶有徇庇。

translations.literal: ministers, saying: "Ying'e'erdai is by nature stubborn; toward people of his own banner he occasionally shows partiality.
translations.idiomatic: ministers: "Ying'e'erdai is stubborn and sometimes favors his banner, yet

sentences.zh: 朕思人鮮有令德，英俄爾岱能殫心部政，治事明決，朕甚嘉之。

translations.literal: I consider that few men have perfect virtue; Ying'e'erdai devotes himself to board affairs, decides matters clearly, and I greatly commend him.
translations.idiomatic: few are flawless; he devotes himself to Revenue with clear decisions, and I commend him.

sentences.zh: 視諸部大臣不如英俄爾岱者多矣！」

translations.literal: Many board ministers are not his equal!"
translations.idiomatic: Many ministers fall short of him!"

sentences.zh: 及睿親王薨，得罪，奪英俄爾岱公爵，降精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When Prince Regent Dorgon died and fell from grace, Ying'e'erdai's ducal rank was stripped and he was reduced to jingginiha fan.
translations.idiomatic: After Dorgon's fall his dukedom was stripped to jingginiha fan.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，輔臣鰲拜專政，陷大學士蘇納海等於死，以英俄爾岱與蘇納海同族，追論初授地不平、附睿親王諸罪狀，奪官。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi period, when minister Oboi monopolized power and framed Grand Secretary Sunahai and others to death, because Ying'e'erdai was of Sunahai's clan, past offenses of unfair initial land grants and attachment to Prince Regent were pursued and his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Under Oboi's dictatorship, kinship with Sunahai brought retroactive charges and loss of office.

sentences.zh: 子宜圖，官至內大臣，襲爵降三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: His son Yitu rose to inner minister and inherited rank reduced to third-rank jingginiha fan.
translations.idiomatic: Son Yitu became inner minister at reduced third-rank jingginiha fan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等子。

translations.literal: In early Qianlong his enfeoffment was fixed as third-rank zi.
translations.idiomatic: Early Qianlong fixed the title as third-rank zi.

sentences.zh: 滿達爾漢，納喇氏，先世居哈達。

translations.literal: Mandarhan, of the Nara clan; his ancestors resided in Hada.
translations.idiomatic: Mandarhan of the Nara clan came from Hada.

sentences.zh: 父雅虎，率十八戶歸太祖，太祖以為牛錄額真，隸滿洲正黃旗。

translations.literal: His father Yahu led eighteen households to submit to Taizu; Taizu made him niru captain and enrolled him in the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Father Yahu submitted with eighteen households and received a Plain Yellow Banner niru.

sentences.zh: 擢扎爾固齊。

translations.literal: He was promoted to jarguci.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to jarguci.

sentences.zh: 與哈穆達尼伐東海卦爾察部，俘二千人以歸，太祖郊勞，與宴。

translations.literal: With Hamudani he attacked the Eastern Sea Guarcia tribe, captured two thousand people and returned; Taizu met him outside the capital and feasted him.
translations.idiomatic: With Hamudani he took two thousand Guarcia captives and was feasted outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 又克舒桑哈達，賜俘百。

translations.literal: He also took Shusanghada and was granted a hundred captives.
translations.idiomatic: He took Shusanghada and received a hundred captives.

sentences.zh: 既乞休，滿達爾漢繼為牛錄額真。

translations.literal: After requesting retirement, Mandarhan succeeded as niru captain.
translations.idiomatic: On Yahu's retirement Mandarhan succeeded the niru.

sentences.zh: 從太宗伐虎爾哈部，降五百餘戶。

translations.literal: He followed Taizong's campaign against the Hurka tribe and reduced more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Taizong against Hurka and reduced five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年五月，上將伐明，規取海中諸島，使滿達爾漢與董納密聘於朝鮮，且徵舟焉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Tiancong the emperor was about to attack Ming and planned to take the offshore islands; he sent Mandarhan and Dongnami as envoys to Korea and also requested boats.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5 he sent Mandarhan and Dongnami to Korea for boats before attacking Ming's islands.

sentences.zh: 時朝鮮初附，未敢開罪於明，滿達爾漢等至朝鮮，國王李倧謝不見，且以兵守館。

translations.literal: Korea had newly submitted and dared not offend Ming; when Mandarhan and others reached Korea, King Li Jong declined to see them and posted troops to guard the lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Newly submitted Korea refused audience and guarded the lodge.

sentences.zh: 越三日，滿達爾漢謂守者曰：「我奉命至此，何慢我不相見？

translations.literal: After three days Mandarhan said to the guards: "I came here by imperial command—why do you treat me with such disrespect in refusing to see me?
translations.idiomatic: After three days Mandarhan told guards: "I came by imperial order—why refuse audience?

sentences.zh: 我歸矣！」

translations.literal: I am leaving!"
translations.idiomatic: I leave!"

sentences.zh: 遂與諸從者佩弓矢，策騎奪門出。

translations.literal: Thereupon he and his followers, wearing bows and arrows, spurred their horses and seized the gate to break out.
translations.idiomatic: He armed his party and broke out through the gate.

sentences.zh: 倧使侍臣追及，請見，滿達爾漢等乃入見，致使命而還。

translations.literal: Jong sent attendants to overtake them and request a meeting; Mandarhan and the others then entered, delivered the mission, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Jong's attendants overtook them; they entered, delivered the mission, and returned.

sentences.zh: 七月，授禮部參政。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was appointed vice commissioner of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he became Rites vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月，復與庫爾？

translations.literal: In the intercalary eleventh month he again went with Ku'er
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month he again went with Ku'erchan

sentences.zh: 等使朝鮮，誡毋縱其民越境採獵，毋匿逃人，並令歲餽當如例，倧乃引咎，原如約。

translations.literal: chan and others as envoys to Korea, admonishing them not to let their people cross the border to hunt, not to harbor fugitives, and also ordering annual tribute as usual; Jong then acknowledged fault and agreed to the terms.
translations.idiomatic: to Korea, forbidding cross-border hunting and harboring fugitives and demanding usual tribute; Jong agreed.

sentences.zh: 八年，太宗自將伐明，攻大同，滿達爾漢分兵克堡四、台一，又拔王家莊。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Taizong personally led a Ming campaign and attacked Datong; Mandarhan with detached troops took four forts and one platform and also captured Wangjiazhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 at Datong he took four forts, one platform, and Wangjiazhuang.

sentences.zh: 以功，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted the hereditary office of niru commander.
translations.idiomatic: Merit earned hereditary niru commander rank.

sentences.zh: 尋擢禮部承政。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to chief of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Rites chief.

sentences.zh: 復使朝鮮。

translations.literal: He was again sent to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: He again went on embassy to Korea.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，克皮島，賜白金、裘、馬。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde he followed Prince Wuying Ajige's Ming campaign, took Pidao, and was granted white gold, fur coats, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he followed Ajige, took Pidao, and received gold, furs, and horses.

sentences.zh: 順治初，世祖定鼎京師，滿達爾漢以老解部任，專領牛錄。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, when the Shizu Emperor fixed the capital at Jingshi, Mandarhan on account of age resigned his board post and solely managed his niru.
translations.idiomatic: At Shunzhi's founding he retired from Rites on account of age.

sentences.zh: 恩詔，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: On an amnesty edict he was promoted to second-rank jalan commander.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty raised him to second-rank jalan.

sentences.zh: 三年，卒，諡敬敏。

translations.literal: In the third year he died and was given the posthumous name Jingmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 3 with posthumous name Jingmin.

sentences.zh: 子阿哈丹，襲職。

translations.literal: His son Ahadan inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: Son Ahadan inherited.

sentences.zh: 恩詔，進一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: On an amnesty edict he was promoted to first-rank adahafan with toshalahafan.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty raised him to first adahafan with toshalahafan.

sentences.zh: 從征福建，擊鄭成功？

translations.literal: On the Fujian campaign he attacked Zheng Chenggong at
translations.idiomatic: On the Fujian campaign he attacked Zheng Chenggong at

sentences.zh: 門，戰死，卹贈三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: Xiamen, was killed in battle, and was posthumously granted third-rank ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiamen, died in battle, and received posthumous third-rank ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 馬福塔，滿達爾漢弟也。

translations.literal: Mafuta was Mandarhan's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Mafuta was Mandarhan's brother.

sentences.zh: 初授牛錄額真，與滿達爾漢分轄所屬人戶。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed niru captain and with Mandarhan divided governance of their households.
translations.idiomatic: He and Mandarhan split their households as co-niru captains.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，授戶部參政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong he was appointed vice commissioner of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5 he became Revenue vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，與戶部承政英俄爾岱如朝鮮互市。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year he went with Revenue Chief Ying'e'erdai to Korea for mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year's third month he traded in Korea with Ying'e'erdai.

sentences.zh: 五月，太宗自將伐明，馬福塔從貝勒濟爾哈朗等居守。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Taizong personally led a Ming campaign; Mafuta followed Prince Jirhala and others in guarding the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he stayed to guard with Jirhala while Taizong campaigned.

sentences.zh: 九月，齎奏詣行營，道明鐵山，明兵邀戰，斬五人，俘一人；

translations.literal: In the ninth month he carried a memorial to the field headquarters; on the road at Ming Tieshan, Ming troops challenged to fight; he beheaded five and captured one;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month en route to camp at Tieshan he killed five Ming soldiers and captured one;

sentences.zh: 又刵一人，縱使還。

translations.literal: he also mutilated one man and released him to return.
translations.idiomatic: he mutilated another and sent him back.

sentences.zh: 尋擢戶部承政。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to chief of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Revenue chief.

sentences.zh: 九年，與參政博爾惠使朝鮮。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he went with Vice Commissioner Boerhui as envoy to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he went to Korea with Boerhui.

sentences.zh: 自是通使朝鮮，馬福塔輒與。

translations.literal: From then on, whenever envoys went to Korea, Mafuta was usually among them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he was on nearly every Korean embassy.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，復與英俄爾岱等使朝鮮，明皮島兵遮道，擊走之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he again went with Ying'e'erdai and others as envoy to Korea; Ming Pidao troops blocked the road and he drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 Ming Pidao troops blocked his Korean embassy; he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 九月，復如朝鮮義州監互市，得明邏卒，知明兵入？

translations.literal: In the ninth month he again went to Yizhou in Korea to supervise mutual trade; he obtained a Ming border soldier and learned Ming troops had entered
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month at Yizhou he learned from a Ming deserter that Ming troops had entered

translations.literal: Yizhou
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou

sentences.zh: ，因率百人躡其後，明兵引去。

translations.literal: , and therefore led a hundred men to follow behind them and the Ming troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: and led a hundred men in pursuit until Ming withdrew.

sentences.zh: 值武英郡王阿濟格等伐明還，渡遼，具舟以濟師。

translations.literal: It happened that Prince Wuying Ajige and others were returning from the Ming campaign; crossing the Liao, they prepared boats to ferry the army.
translations.idiomatic: Ajige's returning army needed boats to cross the Liao; he provided them.

sentences.zh: 十二月，太宗自將伐朝鮮，命馬福塔與勞薩率兵先驅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Taizong personally led a campaign against Korea and ordered Mafuta with Laosa to lead troops as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he and Laosa led the vanguard on Korea.

sentences.zh: 語詳勞薩傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in detail in the biography of Laosa.
translations.idiomatic: Details appear in Laosa's biography.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李倧走保南漢山城，二年正月，師克朝鮮都，進攻南漢山城。

translations.literal: King Li Jong of Korea fled to defend Namhansanseong; in the first month of the second year the army took the Korean capital and advanced to attack Namhansanseong.
translations.idiomatic: Jong fled to Namhansanseong; in the second year's first month the capital fell and the siege continued.

sentences.zh: 馬福塔兩奉敕入城數倧罪，且諭降。

translations.literal: Twice by imperial edict Mafuta entered the city to enumerate Jong's crimes and also instruct him to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Twice by edict he entered the city to list Jong's crimes and demand surrender.

sentences.zh: 倧先使其臣謝罪，尋率？

translations.literal: Jong first sent his ministers to apologize; soon he led his
translations.idiomatic: Jong first sent ministers to apologize; soon he led his

sentences.zh: 僚出城謁上。

translations.literal: staff out of the city to pay respects to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: officials out to pay respects.

sentences.zh: 二月，上班師，倧出送，命馬福塔與英俄爾岱送倧還城。

translations.literal: In the second month, as the army withdrew, Jong came out to see them off; Mafuta and Ying'e'erdai were ordered to escort Jong back to the city.
translations.idiomatic: On withdrawal he and Ying'e'erdai escorted Jong home.

sentences.zh: 倧餽金，？

translations.literal: Jong presented gold; Mafuta
translations.idiomatic: Jong offered gold; Mafuta

sentences.zh: 之，以聞。

translations.literal: refused it and reported this.
translations.idiomatic: refused it and reported.

sentences.zh: 四月，從武英郡王阿濟格攻明皮島，馬福塔攻其齎還，又令朝鮮？

translations.literal: In the fourth month he followed Prince Wuying Ajige in attacking Ming Pidao; Mafuta attacked and returned with booty; he also ordered Korean troops to attack the
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month at Pidao he plundered and ordered Korean troops against the

sentences.zh: 北隅，督戰敗敵。

translations.literal: north corner and directed the battle to defeat the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: north sector, directing the victory.

sentences.zh: 六月，吏議馬福塔從伐朝鮮，私以其子往，得俘獲，先將與貝子碩託交結，罪當死，命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Board of Personnel judged that on the Korea campaign Mafuta had privately taken his son, obtained captives and booty, and beforehand colluded with Prince Shuotuo—offense deserving death; he was ordered to pay a fine to redeem his life.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month collusion with Prince Shuotuo and private gain on the Korea campaign brought a capital sentence commuted to fine.

sentences.zh: 十月，復命與英俄爾岱使朝鮮，冊李倧為朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was again ordered with Ying'e'erdai as envoy to Korea to invest Li Jong as king of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he and Ying'e'erdai reinvested Jong.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，更定官制，改戶部左參政。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year the official system was revised and he was made left vice commissioner of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year's seventh month he became left Revenue vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，命與刑部參政巴哈納使朝鮮，冊倧妃趙氏為王妃。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year he was ordered with Punishments Vice Commissioner Bahana as envoy to Korea to invest Jong's consort Lady Zhao as queen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year's sixth month he invested Lady Zhao as queen.

sentences.zh: 八月，其兄甲喇額真福爾丹從軍退縮，伏法，籍其家畀馬福塔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month his elder brother jalan commander Fu'erdan retreated in battle and was executed; his household was confiscated and given to Mafuta.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month brother Fu'erdan's retreat cost him his life; his estate went to Mafuta.

sentences.zh: 九月，復為戶部承政。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he again became chief of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he again became Revenue chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月，倧疏言立碑三田渡頌上恩，命與禮部參政超哈爾等往察視。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Jong memorialized requesting a stele at Sandu Ferry to praise the emperor's grace; Mafuta was ordered with Rites Vice Commissioner Chaohar and others to go inspect.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Jong sought a stele at Sandu Ferry; Mafuta and Chaohar were sent to inspect.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，卒。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year's second month.

sentences.zh: 明安達禮，西魯特氏，蒙古正白旗人，世居科爾沁。

translations.literal: Ming'andali, of the Xirute clan, a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, whose family had long resided in Khorchin.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'andali, Xirute Mongol of the Plain White Banner, came from Khorchin.

sentences.zh: 父博博圖，率七十餘戶歸太祖，即授牛錄額真，領所屬。

translations.literal: His father Bobotu led more than seventy households to submit to Taizu and was immediately appointed niru captain to lead his following.
translations.idiomatic: Father Bobotu submitted with seventy households and received a niru captaincy.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，從伐明，攻錦州，戰死，予世職游擊，以明安達禮襲，仍兼領牛錄額真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong he followed the Ming campaign, attacked Jinzhou, and died in battle; a hereditary guerrilla office was granted and Ming'andali inherited it, still also leading the niru.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 he died at Jinzhou; Ming'andali inherited guerrilla rank and the niru.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，遷巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was transferred to bayara jalan commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he became bayara jalan commander.

sentences.zh: 從貝勒岳託伐明，自密雲東北毀邊牆以入，與固山額真伊拜共擊敗明太監馮永盛兵，克南和縣。

translations.literal: Following Prince Yueto's Ming campaign, entering by breaking the border wall northeast of Miyun, he with Banner Commander Ibai jointly defeated the troops of Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng and took Nanhe County.
translations.idiomatic: With Prince Yueto he breached the wall near Miyun, defeated Feng Yongsheng, and took Nanhe.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從伐明，圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again followed the Ming campaign and besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he again besieged Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 明兵陣山巔，明安達禮率所部巴牙喇兵陷陣，明兵敗走。

translations.literal: Ming troops formed battle lines on the mountain crest; Ming'andali led his bayara troops in a charge and the Ming army fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He charged Ming on the heights with bayara troops and routed them.

sentences.zh: 既，又有騎兵自松山至，复擊敗之。

translations.literal: Afterward cavalry also came from Songshan and he again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He also repulsed cavalry from Songshan.

sentences.zh: 師阻壕，以守城兵出爭橋，明安達禮迫明兵使引入城。

translations.literal: The army was blocked by moats; garrison troops came out to contest the bridge; Ming'andali pressed the Ming troops and drove them back into the city.
translations.idiomatic: When garrison troops contested the bridge he drove Ming back into the city.

sentences.zh: 上自將擊洪承疇，明安達禮戰尤力，又敗敵騎，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: The emperor personally led the attack on Hong Chengchou; Ming'andali fought with especial force, again defeated enemy cavalry, and was promoted to second-rank jalan commander.
translations.idiomatic: At Hong Chengchou's defeat he fought fiercely, routed enemy cavalry, and rose to second-rank jalan.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，攻薊州，薄明都，擊破明總督趙光抃。

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year he followed Prince Abatai's Ming campaign, attacked Jizhou, approached the Ming capital, and defeated Ming Governor Zhao Guangbian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh winter with Abatai he reached Jizhou, neared Beijing, and defeated Zhao Guangbian.

sentences.zh: 又與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦阿山共擊明​​兵自三河至者，遂進略山東。

translations.literal: Again with Gabsihiyan Gagari Angbang Ashan he jointly defeated Ming troops coming from Sanhe and then advanced to raid Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: With Ashan he defeated Ming from Sanhe and raided Shandong.

sentences.zh: 八年春，與明總兵白廣恩、張登科、和應薦等戰螺山，又與巴牙喇纛章京鰲拜共擊明總督范志完，屢破敵。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year he fought at Luoshan with Ming generals Bai Guang'en, Zhang Dengke, and He Yingjian; again with bayara banner commander Oboi he jointly attacked Ming Governor Fan Zhiwan and repeatedly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At Luoshan and with Oboi against Fan Zhiwan he repeatedly defeated Ming.

sentences.zh: 師還，賚白金。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted white gold.
translations.idiomatic: On return he received white gold.

sentences.zh: 擢禮部參政，兼正白旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice commissioner of the Board of Rites and also meiren commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Rites vice commissioner and Plain White Mongol meiren commander.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the pass and attacked Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he entered the pass against Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 二年，從英親王阿濟格西討，戰延安，七遇皆捷。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige on the western expedition, fought at Yan'an, and was victorious in seven encounters.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he followed Ajige west and won seven battles at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 撫鳳翔等府三十餘城，悉下。

translations.literal: More than thirty prefectures including Fengxiang were pacified and all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified over thirty prefectures including Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 三年，調兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to vice minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he became War vice minister.

sentences.zh: 蘇尼特騰機思叛，從豫親王多鐸帥師討之，別將兵屯險要。

translations.literal: When Sunite Tengjisi rebelled he followed Prince Yu Duo Duo in commanding troops against him and separately led troops to hold strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: Against Sunite rebel Tengjisi he followed Duo Duo and held strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 騰機思遁走，明安達禮夜帥師乘之，及諸鄂特克山，戰大勝，斬台吉茂海，復與鎮國將軍瓦克達等逐北，手斬十一人，獲其輜重。

translations.literal: Tengjisi fled; Ming'andali by night led troops in pursuit, reached Zhuge Tekeshan, won a great victory, beheaded Taiji Maohai, and again with Prince of the State Wakeda and others pursued north, personally beheading eleven men and capturing baggage.
translations.idiomatic: He night-pursued Tengjisi to Zhuge Tekeshan, killed Taiji Maohai, and with Wakeda chased north, killing eleven men himself.

sentences.zh: 复擊敗土謝圖汗、碩類汗。

translations.literal: Again he defeated the Tushatu Khan and the Shuolei Khan.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated the Tushatu and Shuolei khans.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Mongol commander of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he became Plain White Mongol commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，授兵部尚書，九年，列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed minister of the Board of War; in the ninth year he was listed among the Deliberative Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he became War minister; in year 9 he joined the Deliberative Ministers.

sentences.zh: 論功，遇恩詔，累進二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: For merit, on amnesty edicts he was cumulatively promoted to second-rank jingginiha fan.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and amnesties raised him to second-rank jingginiha fan.

sentences.zh: 十年，坐徇總兵任珍擅殺，罷尚書，降一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, for condoning Regional Commander Ren Zhen's unauthorized killing, he was removed as minister and reduced to first-rank adahafan with toshalahafan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 condoning Ren Zhen's unauthorized execution cost him the ministry and one rank.

sentences.zh: 十一年，帥師伐鄂​​羅斯，敗敵黑龍江。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he led troops against Russia and defeated the enemy on the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he campaigned against Russia on the Heilongjiang and won.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he became Colonial Affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 十五年十二月，命為安南將軍，帥師駐防荊州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fifteenth year he was appointed General of Annan and led troops to garrison Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year's twelfth month he garrisoned Jingzhou as General of Annan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，鄭成功入攻江寧，明安達禮帥師赴援。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Zheng Chenggong entered and attacked Jiangning; Ming'andali led troops to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he rushed to relieve Jiangning from Zheng Chenggong.

sentences.zh: 成功將楊文英等以舟千餘泊三山峽，明安達禮擊之，斬副將一，獲其舟及諸攻具，成功引入海。

translations.literal: Chenggong's general Yang Wenying and others anchored more than a thousand boats at Sanshan Gorge; Ming'andali attacked them, beheaded one vice commander, captured their boats and siege equipment, and Chenggong withdrew to sea.
translations.idiomatic: At Sanshan Gorge he destroyed Yang Wenying's fleet and drove Chenggong to sea.

sentences.zh: 上命明安達禮移師駐防舟山。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ming'andali to transfer his army to garrison Zhoushan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then posted him at Zhoushan.

sentences.zh: 十七年，召還，授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was recalled and appointed minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled in year 17, he again became War minister.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he was given the added title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 he received Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 六年，調吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he moved to Personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 引疾，致仕。

translations.literal: Citing illness, he retired.
translations.idiomatic: He retired citing illness.

sentences.zh: 八年，卒，諡敏果。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he died and was given the posthumous name Mingguo.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 8 with posthumous name Mingguo.

sentences.zh: 子都克，襲。

translations.literal: His son Duke inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: Son Duke succeeded.

sentences.zh: 從征噶爾丹有功，授拖沙喇哈番，合為三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: On the campaign against Galdan he had merit and was granted toshalahafan, combined as third-rank ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign merit against Galdan brought toshalahafan combined as third ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 都克孫永安，降襲一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Duke's grandson Yong'an inherited at reduced rank as first-rank adahafan with toshalahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Grandson Yong'an inherited at first adahafan with toshalahafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，從征甘肅石峰堡亂回。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong period he followed the campaign against the rebellious Muslims at Shifeng Fort in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong he fought Muslim rebels at Gansu's Shifeng Fort.

sentences.zh: 官至山海關副都統。

translations.literal: He rose to vice commander at Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: He became Shanhaiguan vice commander.

sentences.zh: 永安孫憲德，憲德子夢麟，自有傳。

translations.literal: Yong'an's grandson Xiande and Xiande's son Menglin have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Yong'an's line through Xiande and Menglin has separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 論曰：國必有所與立，文字其一也。

translations.literal: The commentator says: A state must have foundations on which to stand, and writing is one of them.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator observes that a state must rest on foundations—and writing is one.

sentences.zh: 因蒙古字而製國書，額爾德尼、噶蓋創之，達海成之。

translations.literal: Adapting Mongol letters to make the national script—E Erdeni and Gai created it, and Dahai completed it.
translations.idiomatic: From Mongol letters came the national script: E Erdeni and Gai began it, Dahai perfected it.

sentences.zh: 尼堪等皆兼通蒙、漢文字，出當專對。

translations.literal: Nikan and the others were all versed in Mongol and Chinese writing and went forth to handle diplomacy alone.
translations.idiomatic: Nikan and his peers mastered Mongol and Chinese and handled diplomacy.

sentences.zh: 造邦之始，撫綏之用廣矣。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty the uses of conciliation were far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding such skills of conciliation were indispensable.

sentences.zh: 英俄爾岱領戶部，調兵食最久，見褒於太宗。

translations.literal: Ying'e'erdai headed the Board of Revenue and managed provisions and troops the longest, and was praised by Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Ying'e'erdai's long Revenue tenure won Taizong's praise.

sentences.zh: 明安達禮以折衝禦侮之才，屢長兵部。

translations.literal: Ming'andali, with talent for resisting enemies, repeatedly headed the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'andali, a frontier fighter, repeatedly led the War ministry.

sentences.zh: 蓋皆有功於創業者，故比而次之。

translations.literal: All had merit in founding the enterprise, and so they are grouped and ranked together.
translations.idiomatic: All aided the founding enterprise, and are therefore ranked together.
